m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You’ve been such a help! I’m thinking about writing a Zodiac column for the newspaper back in Marleybone!
I’ll be sure to credit you for all of your assistance... once we get out of here!
Perhaps you could help me, if you’ve got the time to spare? I’m a journalist, traveling with the expedition.
It’s my duty to chronicle the exploration and to provide information to my readers about what Celestia was like.
To that end, I need to learn all I can about Celestian culture. The Celestian zodiac fascinates me!
They left teaching devices around their city, so that life was full of knowledge about the stars that guided them.
Could you read the Celestian Tomes of the Zodiac around the city and learn about them? Your help will be invaluable!
Have you finished learning from the Tomes of the Zodiac located all over Celestia?
